payload.title: Reject orders when there isn't enough stock. Before placing an order, check availability with the inventory team's Stock API: GET https://stock.inventory.internal/v1/stock/{sku} returns { "sku": string, "available": number }. If any line asks for more than is available, POST /orders must return 409.

payload.content:
Implemented stock validation for order placement.

- Production now calls `GET https://stock.inventory.internal/v1/stock/{sku}` through `HttpStockGateway`.
- `createApp` accepts injectable `stockGateway`.
- Orders with insufficient availability return `409` / `insufficient_stock`.
- Stock is checked before payment, persistence, and event publication; duplicate SKU quantities are combined.
- Inventory connectivity/malformed-response failures return `502`.
